subject: executor: replace `Call` with `CallWithRecover` in the close of hash join v1 (#61868)
summary: Reviewed the commit relative to its parent: it adds local panic recovery around `HashJoinV1Exec`'s `RowContainer.Close()` so a panic no longer skips `BaseExecutor.Close()` (and thus child executor cleanup), plus a failpoint-backed regression test. No remaining Blocker/High issues found. Later upstream adjusted joinv1 Close to log `RowContainer.Close()` errors instead of returning them (ea2ff4d473).
